mapper.sql: r.organization_uuid, r.prompt_uuid, r.revision_uuid, CAST(r.payload AS text) AS payload_json, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.insert: WITH target_prompt AS ( SELECT uuid FROM workbench_prompts WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND prompt_uuid = #{params.PromptUUID} LIMIT 1 ) INSERT INTO workbench_prompt_revisions ( organization_uuid, prompt_ref_uuid, prompt_uuid, revision_uuid, payload, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.OrganizationUUID}, target_prompt.uuid, #{params.PromptUUID}, #{params.RevisionUUID}, CAST(#{params.PayloadJSON,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM target_prompt ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, prompt_ref_uuid, revision_uuid) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
